name: Compile lists of characters and entities from media
description: Users asked for exhaustive or ranked lists of characters, casts, and entities from specific media franchises, real-world figures, or fictional universes. Some requests included specific filters based on character traits, roles, abilities, or power rankings, while others sought comprehensive compilations of all members within a defined category.
